Tam Nguyen: quick pass on the batch sample preview modal — noticed CTAs order is confusing for keyboard/VO users, and VoiceOver currently reads Export before the sample meta. can we quick-iterate? Priya Shah: which exact modal? the one under Vectors > Batch > Preview? Tam Nguyen: yep. repro steps: upload batch -> hover row -> click Preview. modal header shows sample title + meta and on the top-right there are three small CTAs: Rerank | Export | Open. VO reads 'Export button' first on my machine. Eleni Markos: that sounds like DOM order vs visual layout mismatch — probably Export was added later so it sits earlier in the DOM. can you paste the snippet? Tam Nguyen: paste of DOM (simplified): ```

Sample 23

``` Noah Chen: proposal — re-order DOM to match visual intent: primary action (Rerank) should be first for keyboard/tab flow only if it's the main user task, otherwise make primary 'Open' and keep tertiary 'Download CSV'. also make sure tabindex follows DOM order. for voiceover add `aria-describedby` on the heading to reference sample summary. A11y QA: quick note from testing: screen readers follow DOM order, yes. aria-flowto is not reliable cross-platform. best fix is change DOM order so SR + keyboard get the right sequence, or use `role="toolbar"` with logical DOM order. also add an `aria-live="polite"` region for dynamic sample counts. Priya Shah: microcopy suggestion: change text from 'Export' to 'Download CSV' and tooltip to 'Download selected samples as CSV' — clearer for non-technical PMs. also keep short labels on buttons (Rerank). Tam Nguyen: keyboard/interaction notes: when opening preview, focus should land inside modal on first interactive element (sample row or primary CTA), not on the close button. and when selections change, announce: `aria-live=polite` -> 'Showing 10 samples — 2 selected.' Eleni Markos: i'll mock two variants: (A) reorder DOM to [Rerank, Open, Download CSV] with visual CTAs right-aligned; (B) keep visual order but move a hidden sr-only region that lists actions in preferred order. which do we prefer? Noah Chen: variant A is cleaner for a11y/keyboard. variant B is hacky and brittle. +1 for DOM reorder. Also +1 on 'Download CSV' label. Tam Nguyen: tiny copy nit: change tooltip for Rerank to 'Rerank selected samples — quick relevance shuffle' instead of just 'Rerank'. Priya Shah: agree on the tooltip change, but keep the visible label 'Rerank'. DesignBot: Created issue #4821: "Batch preview: CTA DOM order, VO reading order, Download CSV microcopy" and assigned to Eleni Markos. :white_check_mark: A11y QA: i'll add a quick VoiceOver checklist to the issue (keyboard tab order, focus trap, aria-live announcements, label clarity). Eleni Markos: i'll upload mocks by EOD and include a small iframe of VoiceOver narration notes. thanks all! :thumbsup:
